title: A covering cone over a finite etale tower
statement: Let X be a scheme in universe u, P_n finite etale X-schemes and p_n:P_(n+1)→P_n X-maps. Suppose at every separably closed geometric point of X all fibers of P_n are finite and nonempty. Then there is a pro-etale cover indexed by Type u and maps from each covering object to every P_n, commuting with all p_n. No transition is assumed surjective. Definitions: [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism], [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks].

proof.text: Restrict to the affine cover of X and pull back every finite etale stage. These pullbacks are affine and form a tower W in AffineProEt over each affine open. Use the explicit source-library AffineProEt.seqLimit, Spec of the colimit of the global-section ring sequence. Its proAffineEtale structure supplies weak etaleness; both source and base are affine, so its structure map is quasi-compact. The concrete constructor is AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.AffineProEt.seqLimit in WeilConjectures.AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.SequentialLimit; its data is constructed, not selected from an existence assertion. Its indEtale_colimit_ι_zero proof uses the source-library RingHom.IndEtale.of_isColimit and proAffineEtale_Spec_iff of [sk-def-pe-morphisms]. The separate principal-Zariski/ind-etale aggregate is not used.

For a separably closed geometric point over an affine open, projection to the original finite etale stage injects the pullback Hom fiber into the original finite fiber; the pullback lift supplies a point from any original fiber point. Thus all pullback Hom fibers are finite and nonempty. Apply Mathlib nonempty_sections_of_finite_inverse_system to the ofOpSequence tower followed by the Over-category geometric-point Hom functor. Map compatibility gives a cocone of global-section rings. Its colimit desc and toSpecΓ define a map to seqLimit; colimit.ι_desc and toSpecΓ_naturality prove every projection equation. At each base point take the separable closure of its residue field; the lifted geometric point proves surjectivity of the limit structure map.

The affine limit structure map is surjective, quasi-compact and weakly etale, hence its singleton belongs to proetalePrecoverage. Bind these singleton covers with the affine open cover. Compose the sequential-limit projections with the pullback first projections to obtain maps to the original P_n. Congruence on seqLimitπ_comp followed by pullback.lift_fst proves compatibility. All covering indices stay in Type u.

lean.statement:
theorem finite_etale_tower_cone_cover
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (P : ℕ → X.Etale) (p : ∀ n : ℕ, P (n + 1) ⟶ P n)
    (hfin : ∀ n : ℕ, IsFinite (P n).hom)
    (hpoints : ∀ (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [IsSepClosed Ω]
      (x : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ X) (n : ℕ),
      Finite ((pointSmallEtale x).fiber.obj (P n)) ∧
        Nonempty ((pointSmallEtale x).fiber.obj (P n))) :
    ∃ (J : Type u) (U : J → X.ProEt),
      Presieve.ofArrows (fun j ↦ (U j).left) (fun j ↦ (U j).hom) ∈
          proetalePrecoverage X ∧
      ∃ a : ∀ (j : J) (n : ℕ), U j ⟶ (toProEt X).obj (P n),
        ∀ (j : J) (n : ℕ), a j (n + 1) ≫ (toProEt X).map (p n) = a j n
